schema.description: Page number for the Model List. The starting value is 1, and the default value is 1.
The number of models displayed per page in a paged query. The default value is 10.

Specifies ascending or descending order for the designated sorting field during a paged query. The default value is ASC.  

ASC: ascending order.  
DESC: descending order.

The field used for sorting in a paged query. Currently, the GmtCreateTime field is used for sorting. Supported values include:

- GmtCreateTime: Creation Time of the model

- GmtLatestVersionModified: Update Time of the latest model version

- OrderNumber: Ordinal number

The model name used for configuration. By default, a fuzzy match is applied to retrieve the model list. Enclose the name in double quotes for an exact match. For example, specifying "DeepSeek-V3.2" performs an exact match for the model DeepSeek-V3.2.
Specify a domain to filter the Model List within that domain. For example: aigc (generative AI), nlp (natural language processing), cv (computer vision), and so on.
Job. For example: large-language-model, image-classification, embedding, etc.
Configure the model source to filter the model list belonging to a specific community or organization, such as ModelScope, PAI, NIM, etc.
Model type.
The collection to which the model belongs. Models in ModelGallery belong to the QuickStart collection.

Model series.  
PAI Optimized Model, Qwen, Wan-AI, GLM, Baichuan, DeepSeek, Kimi, MiniMax, Yi, InternLM, InternVL, OpenAI, NVIDIA, Gemma, Phi, dots_vlm, Llama, Mistral, Stable Diffusion, FLUX, Byte Dance, StepFun AI, ERNIE Bot, Tencent Hunyuan, YOLO, etc.
Indicates whether online experience is supported.
Indicates whether deployment is supported.
Supported deployment resources, such as CPU, GPU, GP7V, etc. For example, if GP7V is specified, the filter returns models that support deployment on GP7V resources.
Indicates whether training is supported.
Supported training resources, such as CPU, GPU, GP7V, etc. For example, if GP7V is specified, filter models that support GP7V for training.
Indicates whether evaluation is supported.
Supported evaluation resources, such as CPU, GPU, GP7V, etc. For example, if GP7V is specified, the filter returns models that support evaluation on GP7V resources.
Indicates whether compression is supported.
Supported compression resources, such as CPU, GPU, GP7V, etc. If GP7V is specified, only models that support compression on GP7V resources are filtered.
Indicates whether distillation is supported.
Supported distillation resources, such as CPU, GPU, GP7V, etc. If GP7V is specified, only models that support distillation on GP7V resources are filtered.
Indicates whether deep thinking is supported.
Indicates whether FunctionCall is supported.
List of tags.
List of conditions.

Column.description: Parameter Name. Supported values include ParameterSize, in MB.

Value.description: Value. If Column is ParameterSize, enter an integer in MB.
